central_rule: A consequential process must retain custody of threat, evidence, support, welfare, restrictions, safety handoff, authorship and later learning; institutional uncertainty may not be exported entirely to the person.

controls.name: severity_over_label
controls.requirement: Trigger safeguards from practical threat severity, not the informal, preliminary, fact-finding, criminal, regulatory or disciplinary label.

controls.name: advance_notice_and_scope
controls.requirement: Provide written purpose, allegation scope, attendees, process stage and preparation rights before a consequential meeting unless an evidenced emergency exception applies.

controls.name: bounded_outcome_statement
controls.requirement: State the realistic current outcome range and what is not presently supported, while preserving revision when evidence changes.

controls.name: evidence_provenance
controls.requirement: Retain complaint source, corroboration, exculpatory material, conflicts, chain of custody and disclosure decisions.

controls.name: companion_and_advocate
controls.requirement: Offer a suitable companion, representative or advocate when the process carries material job, liberty, family, reputation or welfare consequences.

controls.name: restriction_receipt
controls.requirement: Name the author, basis, proportionality, review date and non-prejudgment status of each interim restriction.

controls.name: independent_welfare_owner
controls.requirement: Place welfare ownership outside the allegation, investigation, restriction and final-decision chain.

controls.name: distress_stop
controls.requirement: Visible or reported acute distress triggers pause, documented assessment and an independent decision about whether the process can safely continue.

controls.name: same_day_safety_handoff
controls.requirement: Assign named same-day, overnight and next-day contact with clear emergency escalation and consent boundaries.

controls.name: cross_system_handoff
controls.requirement: Join employer, police, court, healthcare and custody risk information without erasing legal boundaries or creating unsupported guilt inferences.

controls.name: named_decision_authorship
controls.requirement: Preserve who classified the process, bounded risk, denied or allowed support, imposed restrictions and owned follow-up.

controls.name: time_limit_and_reopen_trigger
controls.requirement: Set a reviewable deadline, delay explanation and escalation trigger for processes whose uncertainty creates ongoing harm.

controls.name: effective_challenge
controls.requirement: Provide a timely route to correct evidence, restrictions, support failures and process classification before irreversible harm.

controls.name: post_event_investigation
controls.requirement: Require an independent learning investigation after a death or severe harm plausibly linked to work events, without predetermining causation.

controls.name: implementation_verification
controls.requirement: Do not treat training, policy text, apology or promised review as completion without live-process evidence and independent verification.

controls.name: sentinel_population_learning
controls.requirement: Reconcile later cases, appeals, exits, silence, sickness absence, protected signals, restoration and external findings rather than validating on survivors alone.

non_entitlements: The protocol does not determine whether an allegation is true.
A safeguard does not create immunity from proportionate investigation or lawful restriction.
A sentinel comparison does not prove identical causation across cases.
A completed receipt does not establish legal compliance or eliminate substantive review.

states.question: What event, complaint, allegation or concern initiated the process?
Was practical job, liberty, family, reputation or status risk accurately bounded?
Was advance notice and a realistic preparation window provided?
Were allegation provenance, corroboration and exculpatory evidence preserved and disclosed?
Could the person obtain an appropriate companion, representative or advocate?
Were restrictions named, proportionate, reviewed and marked non-prejudicial?
Was welfare owned outside the allegation, investigation and decision chain?
Did expressed or visible distress trigger a documented assessment?
Was there a named same-day, overnight or next-day safety handoff?
Who owned classification, restrictions, support, escalation and final decisions?
Was an effective challenge, appeal or correction path available in time?
Did response become verified implementation, recurrence review and population learning?
